items.question: What ritual object emerges from the fire-pit following the prescribed worship?
premises: The preceding worship involves offerings of flowers and sugar.
A pill designated by the name vetāla is the subject.
This pill comes forth from the middle of the fire-pit.
items.inference: As a result of the prescribed worship, a vetāla-named pill emerges from the middle of the fire-pit.
uncertainties: The specific nature or function of the vetāla-named pill is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And a pill named vetāla comes forth from the middle of the fire-pit.
